content:
A moment of growth. ⚖️✨

I am pleased to share that I have received a Letter of Recommendation (LoR) from Record Of Law in recognition of my successful completion of their International Special 2-Week Legal Internship Program, held from 24 June to 07 July 2026.

The LoR recognised my work in legal research, analytical reasoning, legal writing, professionalism, adaptability, and willingness to learn. I am truly grateful to the team for acknowledging my efforts and recommending me for future academic, research, and professional opportunities. 🤍

Along with this milestone, I am also happy to share that my legal research work has been published on the official website of Record Of Law 

📚 Article: “AI & Indian Legal System: Challenges, Regulations and Accountability”

📖 Case Summary: I.C. Golak Nath & Ors. v. State of Punjab & Anr.

These publications gave me an opportunity to explore important legal issues, strengthen my research and analytical skills, and develop my legal writing.

As someone who has gained practical experience through court practice, this experience has encouraged me to explore new areas of law and continue growing professionally.

A special thank you to the Publication Team at Record Of Law and Co-Founder Rafia Naaz for this valuable opportunity and recognition.
comment: AI and legal research will increasingly require lawyers to balance efficiency with verification. The ability to question outputs, trace sources, and apply legal judgment may become as important as drafting skills.
